blocks.text: When you’re trapped in a cycle of addiction, recovery can feel impossible, leading treatment to feel futile. Every year, 1.3 million Americans seek treatment for alcohol addiction, but that accounts for less than 10% of those who need treatment. If you’re ready to move past the pain of alcoholism, know that inpatient rehab is the gold standard in treatment. Toronto Addiction Centre can help you make the journey from addiction to sobriety, and we think you might be surprised to see how quickly your life improves.

blocks.text: You’ve probably heard that admitting you have a problem is the first step toward getting better. This is because until you realize the power of your addiction, your ability to combat it is severely compromised. Many recovering alcoholics are concerned that rehab will take too long, or that it will remove them from their homes or families. The truth, though, is that alcoholism has already undermined your ability to live your life. An alcohol rehab program is a ticket to regaining control.

blocks.text: Some benefits of an inpatient alcohol rehab treatment program include:
blocks.html: Some benefits of an inpatient alcohol rehab treatment program include:

items.text: A break from the stress of a dysfunctional family, a demanding career, and the everyday stresses of life.
items.html: A break from the stress of a dysfunctional family, a demanding career, and the everyday stresses of life.

items.text: Safe and supportive alcohol and drug-free environment.
items.html: Safe and supportive alcohol and drug-free environment.

items.text: Coordination of care at a single location, ensuring you don’t have to travel to different offices or worry that one treatment provider doesn’t know what the other is doing.
items.html: Coordination of care at a single location, ensuring you don’t have to travel to different offices or worry that one treatment provider doesn’t know what the other is doing.

items.text: A chance to draw upon the wisdom and experience of other recovering alcoholics.
items.html: A chance to draw upon the wisdom and experience of other recovering alcoholics.

items.text: Support and medical care whenever you need it.
items.html: Support and medical care whenever you need it.

blocks.text: Though every alcohol rehab facility offers something a bit different, every good rehab center endeavors to serve your emotional, physical, and social needs. At most rehab facilities, you can expect access to:
blocks.html: Though every alcohol rehab facility offers something a bit different, every good rehab center endeavors to serve your emotional, physical, and social needs. At most rehab facilities, you can expect access to:

items.text: Therapy—Therapy enables you to gain a keener understanding of your addiction, identify your triggers for use, and implement new coping skills for managing old problems.
items.html: Therapy—Therapy enables you to gain a keener understanding of your addiction, identify your triggers for use, and implement new coping skills for managing old problems.

items.text: Group support—Group programs such as Alcoholics Anonymous allow you to benefit from the wisdom and experience of other addicts. By working through these programs, you’ll steadily gain the coping skills you need and move beyond the pain of addiction.
items.html: Group support—Group programs such as Alcoholics Anonymous allow you to benefit from the wisdom and experience of other addicts. By working through these programs, you’ll steadily gain the coping skills you need and move beyond the pain of addiction.

items.text: Medical care—Alcoholism can steadily wreck your health. We offer you medical care to help manage any alcohol-related health conditions you may experience. We’ll also help you implement healthy lifestyle changes that can help you restore your health.
items.html: Medical care—Alcoholism can steadily wreck your health. We offer you medical care to help manage any alcohol-related health conditions you may experience. We’ll also help you implement healthy lifestyle changes that can help you restore your health.

items.text: Detox assistance—The first days after you quit drinking is typically the most challenging. From managing detox-related medical symptoms to offering you psychological support as you journey toward chemical sobriety, detox support helps you master the earliest stage of sobriety.

blocks.text: If you’re an alcohol addict, you can benefit from rehab. Nevertheless, some addicts are able to get sober with outpatient care only. If you’re unsure whether your addiction is severe enough to warrant inpatient care, review the questions below. If you answer yes to more than three, you’ll probably need inpatient care to get clean:

items.html: Do you mix alcohol with other drugs?

items.html: Have you previously struggled with addiction, to alcohol or another drug?

items.text: Does your family have a history of alcoholism?
items.html: Does your family have a history of alcoholism?

items.text: Have you relapsed?

blocks.text: Don’t let the hopelessness of alcoholism erode the possibility of a wonderful, fulfilling life. Addiction Rehab Centres Canada can show you a path out of the darkness of alcoholism, but it’s up to you to make that first call for help.
